sensorPhysics: Gravity-tared Fcell = Fc - distalMass * surfaceAcceleration; native Simulink Sum/Gain blocks before force-sensor sampling. Acceleration enters only the physical measurement equation. The controller receives measured force and magnet position, not surface truth.
calibratedObserver: Private helper copy replaces the measurement row Cf with Cf - distalMass*surfaceAccelerationState; estimated true-force control row remains Cf. No plant dynamics are changed.
scopeLimitations: Sensing and placement grids use the baseline fully-rigid observer weights unless explicitly stated. They do not establish the sensor envelope of a separately tuned compliant design.
The sensor is gravity-tared exactly, so imperfect mass/orientation compensation would introduce additional static error.
Rows rejected by covariance synthesis have null numerical metrics and are counted as attempts, not successful simulations.
Rate screen uses one extra unknown force sample per rate; the single-link robustness phase also tests absolute delay at 10 kHz.
